channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Announcing Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway – expanding access to Cloudflare’s privacy-preserving infrastructure
item.description: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products. (2 sources: cloudflare, lobsters)

item.title: Istio 1.31 Adds Agentgateway Waypoints and Moves Release Artifacts off Google Cloud
item.description: Istio 1.31 adds agentgateway waypoints in ambient mode, with a canary configuration fix included in 1.31.1. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon ECS adds Amazon VPC Lattice support for blue/green, linear, and canary deployments
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now supports built-in blue/green, linear, and canary deployment strategies for ECS services using Amazon VPC Lattice . (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Health introduces the version catalog for software lifecycle management
item.description: Today, AWS Health introduces the version catalog which provides a centralized source of lifecycle information for software versions across AWS services. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports partial indexes
item.description: Amazon Aurora DSQL now lets you build an index over a specific subset of a table, storing only qualifying rows rather than every row in the entire table, which improves query performance and lowers index storage cost. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EKS and Amazon EKS Distro now support Kubernetes version 1.37
item.description: Kubernetes version 1.37 introduced several new features and bug fixes, and AWS is excited to announce that you can now use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and Amazon EKS Distro to run Kubernetes version 1.37. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Brazil automates distribution of non-Brazilian software product licenses to Brazilian customers
item.description: AWS Brazil now provides an automated distribution workflow through the AWS Brazil 2P Distribution Program. (1 source: aws)

item.title: The AWS MCP Server is now available in six additional AWS Regions
item.description: The AWS MCP Server is now available in six additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Ireland), Europe (London), and US West (Oregon). (1 source: aws)
